shortDescription: Foreign investment flows into China in yuan terms were down 5.3% to 479.95 billion yuan ($71.66 billion) in the first eight months of 2026 from a year before, data from China's commerce ministry showed on Friday.($1 = 6.6976 Chinese yuan renminbi)
